content.bridge_context: We explore why and how we separate mixtures of materials to obtain useful components or remove impurities.

units.title: Why Separate?
units.explanation: We separate substances to remove harmful components, remove non-useful parts, or to get two different useful components.
units.dual_language_instruction: Think about why tea is filtered. / सोचें कि चाय को क्यों छाना जाता है।

units.title: Methods of Separation
units.explanation: Based on the physical state and size of particles, we use methods like Handpicking, Winnowing, Sieving, and Sedimentation.
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify tools used for separation (Sieve, Strainer, Fan). / पृथक्करण के लिए उपयोग किए जाने वाले उपकरणों (छलनी, पंखा) की पहचान करें।
